name: @specstride/host-hermes
description: The Hermes host of Specstride (specs/150-host-hermes): the third implementation of the host port EP-01 (specstride.host/1), rendering the host-kit skills through a Hermes profile, with the shim specstride-hermes, an installer with an install record, the eight host.* doctor checks, the thin specstride plugin glue, Telegram push notices and the session-log eval driver. Everything of the engine arrives through the pinned core tarballs in vendor/core/; Hermes itself is consumed on PATH, never a dependency.

scripts.gate: npm run pin:check && npm run build && npm test && npm run conformance && hermes plugins validate hermes-plugin/specstride
